scripts.plugin:check: cd plugin/dsh-desktop-bridge && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.plugins:check: for d in plugin/*/; do d=${d%/}; [ -L "$d" ] && continue; echo "== $d"; (cd "$d" && pnpm run --if-present typecheck && pnpm run --if-present test && pnpm run --if-present build) || exit 1; done
